name: Postherpetic Neuralgia
definition: Persistent neuropathic pain in a dermatomal distribution after herpes zoster, typically with burning pain, allodynia or sensory disturbance.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is usually clinical; investigations are reserved for atypical features.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Persistent severe pain may need multidisciplinary pain care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-daha/vedana phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Persistent neuropathic pain in a dermatomal distribution after herpes zoster, typically with burning pain, allodynia or sensory disturbance.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
